tool: Hunyuan3D-2 multi-view, public Hugging Face Space tencent/Hunyuan3D-2mv, endpoint /shape_generation
prompt: None. The model takes view images and no text. The front and back views are cut from the character sheet and enlarged two times with nearest-neighbour. The two side views are generated images, see side_views.
usage: Base shape for the print model and the website model. assets/3d/brundlefly/build_from_mesh.py removes the bristle spikes for printing, thickens thin parts, cuts the smaller wing back to the sheet's outline, adds the base and the eyeballs, and projects the four views onto the colours.
licence_note: The Space runs Tencent's Hunyuan3D-2 multi-view model. Its community licence sets terms for the model and for use of its output. Nobody reviewed that licence for this project. Check it before commercial use of this mesh.

side_views.prompt: Make TWO images: the right side view and the left side view of the existing Brundlefly mascot, in the same pose, pixel-art style, palette, and level of detail as the attached character sheet and its front and back views. Strict orthographic side views on a pure black background. Right side: the figure faces the left edge, the nearest leg is dark segmented chitin with a clawed insect foot, the nearest wing is the larger wing. Left side: the figure faces the right edge, the nearest leg is rusty flesh with a human-like foot, the nearest wing is the smaller wing. Full body, standing, strongly hunched, long arm hanging beside the body, small arm held forward, mouthparts hanging in front of the chest, narrow blue-black eye with a teal glint, dark segmented plates along the back.
side_views.usage: Left and right inputs for the shape generation, and colour for surfaces that face sideways.
side_views.known_issue: The brief asked for each side view with the figure facing the wrong way, so each image is a mirror image of a true side view. The outline is unaffected. The generator's own convention for its left and right inputs was not verified.
